_what: Total wall-clock cost per trial for the inspection-order ablation: the time to open the regions the trial actually inspected, plus the grounding time (region inspection + perception + phi).
_composition: total = (per-region opening cost x regions opened) + grounding_seconds. The FM-ranked arm is the reference and takes grounding_seconds as measured. The fixed-order arm's grounding_seconds is divided by (1 + drift), where drift is read from the Living Room negative control: that scene declares no inspectable regions, so both arms run it identically and any difference it shows is measurement drift rather than an ordering effect. Here drift = 8.00/6.77 - 1 = 0.1817.
_kitchen_caveat: Workshop opening cost is per-region and measured (benchmark_reports/workshop_open_costs.json). For kitchen only the per-region mean was retained, so the kitchen totals are carried here as measured rather than recomposed: the retained mean reproduces the FM-ranked column to 0.01 s but the fixed-order column only to ~0.4 s, because the two arms open different mixes of cabinets, drawers and the lidded box, which do not cost the same.
_living_room: Living Room has no inspectable regions and no opening cost, so its total is grounding time alone, and both arms are reported at the reference value because their computation is identical.
